verdict.rationale: BigQuery documents several programmatic interfaces. The Storage Write API (gRPC and REST) supports real-time streaming and atomic batch commits. ODBC/JDBC drivers connect applications to BigQuery features, a Rust SDK is in Preview, and query results can be retrieved directly in Apache Arrow format. Together these show the product can be driven through documented public APIs. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of the core REST API reference for jobs, datasets and tables management; documentation of API authentication or rate limits; and independent hands-on corroboration of API-driven use.
